title: Multi-facet target support rays with active entrance belief
summary: Transport non-OCR public-reference identity through native reciprocal patch support to entrance candidates, preserve ambiguous candidates, and actively acquire a closer view before committing or reacquiring.

mechanisms.name: Native target-support ray
mechanisms.description: Build a discriminative native DINO patch field from reciprocal affine-consistent public-reference matches; cast support downward in image columns and bind only entrance proposals below target evidence.
mechanisms.limitations: V7 reduced false commits by 76.7 percent and reached proposal-oracle candidate coverage, but did not increase correct unique commits. It is not a finished single-frame locator.

mechanisms.name: Active multi-view entrance belief
mechanisms.description: Treat SET_VALUED as an observation request; center and approach a candidate, require consecutive target-bound survival after competitors clear, and reacquire a lost commit from its last bearing.
outputs: Temporal SEARCH, SET_VALUED, COMMIT, or REACQUIRE state
mechanisms.limitations: The deterministic sequence check passes, but no public active-view video has yet established temporal disambiguation, tracking, approach, or arrival.
